## 维护者速读

- **事由：** Setup 的错误提示带错误码、字段路径和 ADR 说明，软件包的一个错误在 400 像素的面板里占 11 行。
- **要做：** 先显示一句白话，错误码和细节收进「更多」。
- **完成标准：** 这几处错误首屏只有一句话。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U07**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** Packages, Positions, OAuth; the system administrator.
- **Now:** errors with codes and ADR prose: "[writable_package_required] … (ADR-0131 D6) …", "The compound '<section>/<name>' spelling is retired …", "[body.redirect_uris.0] Invalid URL".
- **Cost:** the package error is 11 lines in a 400 px sheet.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-07; [`02-apps-packages-action-publish.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-action-publish.png), [`12-access-positions-new-invalid-name.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/12-access-positions-new-invalid-name.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The console's error rendering for refused writes on these Setup pages (the shared error/toast path, and the metadata editor's refusal banner). The server's message stays the source; the console shows its first sentence, or a user-facing field where the envelope carries one, and folds the code and detail behind "More".

## Done when

- On the three pages above, a refusal shows one plain sentence first, with the code and detail one click away.
- Nothing the server sent is dropped (the detail is still reachable and copyable).
- Tests on the shared renderer.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `error render`, `plain sentence`, `more`, `error code`. 0 hits. **New.**
